title: Anthropic · 博客来源更新
summary: 博客更新：新增 Agent Skills 捐赠和生命科学客座研究员招募，删除旧的支持科学家和福祉研究公告，反映战略重点转移。

added_lines: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.

We’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025.
removed_lines: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing

Starting today, 10,000 scientists around the world can get Claude at no cost to start. Verified principal investigators qualify for a Claude Team subscription plan and then add their research team to Standard seats for free, or Premium seats for $15 per month, for up to a year.
We’re launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.
